LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are the words and, but and, or used in conversation?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the conjunctions and, but and or in sentences
2. use and, but and or in sentences accurately
3. appreciate the importance of proper use of conjunctions in written and spoken contexts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 CONJUNCTIONS
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 CONJUNCTIONS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify the conjunctions and, but and or in sentences

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the conjunctions and, but and or in sentences. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the conjunctions and, but and or in sentences.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the conjunctions and, but and or in sentences. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use and, but and or in sentences accurately

What this means
In this part you learn to use and, but and or in sentences accurately. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use and, but and or in sentences accurately.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use and, but and or in sentences accurately. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the importance of proper use of conjunctions in written and spoken contexts

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the importance of proper use of conjunctions in written and spoken contexts. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the importance of proper use of conjunctions in written and spoken contexts.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model writing: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the importance of proper use of conjunctions in written and spoken contexts. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify the conjunctions and, but and or in sentences)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions to a partner. (skill: use and, but and or in sentences accurately)

Example 3: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson. (skill: appreciate the importance of proper use of conjunctions in written and spoken contexts)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the conjunctions and, but and or in sentences.
3. Practise this skill: use and, but and or in sentences accurately.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of proper use of conjunctions in written and spoken contexts.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are the words and, but and, or used in conversation?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Grammar In Use 9.3.1 Conjunctions means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the conjunctions and, but and or in sentences.
5. Be able to: use and, but and or in sentences accurately.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
